scope: Bounded read-only local alias identity evidence review; no scientific re-review of 228 groups, source-status remeasurement, provider/private/output search, or network request.

conclusion.what_follows: Exact XML equality establishes identical exported metadata content and descriptive assertions within a pair. Shared bibliography references can help locate the cited literature metadata. Neither establishes historical catalogue priority, source-node lineage, owner preference, a unique scientific dataset entity, or an existing provider identity.
conclusion.representative_limit: The smallest numerical member in the existing map is explicitly a stable review-display representative; it is not an authoritative canonical_source_id. The +228 offset is an observed numbering pattern only.

bounded_embedded_identifier_check.method: Parsed one already-frozen representative original XML per byte group with stdlib ElementTree. Verified each representative SHA-256 against the existing map. Enumerated every tag name and attribute; examined nonempty explicit ID/UUID/onlink/resdesc/othercit/docid/fileid/metid/datasetid values and raw FGDC-number, UUID-pattern, DOI, and Zenodo literals. The choice of representative is purely for scanning identical content.
bounded_embedded_identifier_check.limit: This is a bounded absence check in the frozen XML, not proof that external catalogue IDs or existing remote records do not exist.

existing_reference_tiers.crosswalk_interpretation: ProCite identifies historical bibliography/Excel rows. Uniqueness within these 228 groups does not establish a global identifier, choose between duplicate local filenames, or identify a provider record.

exact_source_quotes.quote: The ProCite database record number corresponds to the Excel Procite Number.
exact_source_quotes.additional_literal: Reference Procite #493 for this literature's metadata.

exact_source_quotes.quote: The metadata are maintained in digital format (ArcView 3.3, Excel 2002, and Procite) and are available from the Alaska Science Center, USGS in Anchorage, Alaska.
Reference Procite #0 for this literature's metadata.
exact_source_quotes.limit: The same zero literal occurs in 12 different byte groups and is not a unique key.

title_collision_protection.consequence: A shared title must not attach these two different byte groups to the retained record. Different ProCite values and abstracts are preserved. No current remote state is asserted.

prior_public_context_reused_without_netw.retained_quote: The redundancies were created by importing each other’s metadata records to expand individual metadata holdings.
prior_public_context_reused_without_netw.limit: Historical federation context motivates import/export provenance research. It does not prove the cause or canonical member of any specific local pair.

field_crosswalk_is_not_identity_crosswal.header: FGDC element,FGDC path,FGDC short name,What it means (FGDC),Zenodo JSON target,Mapping rationale / notes,Transform / normalization,Fallback if not supported
field_crosswalk_is_not_identity_crosswal.meaning: Schema field mappings only; not an original catalogue-record-to-export-filename or provider-record crosswalk.

smallest_irreducible_source_crosswalk_qu: Can the original catalogue/export owner provide the manifest and field definitions mapping both FGDC filenames in each frozen byte group to original catalogue record ID/UUID and source/import provenance, including the GEM ProCite-to-Excel mapping where applicable, and identify any authoritative primary/preferred source designation? Without that designation, source canonical priority remains unknown.
separate_provider_requirement: Any provider canonical target still requires authoritative existing IDs/DOIs, owner/version, and exact source-file or notes bindings plus explicit disposition preserving existing records. A source bibliography crosswalk does not supply these facts.
historical_receipt_limits: Prior receipt status totals and non-alias diagnostics are historical; this task does not restate them as current measurements. Parent independently measures current all-456 mapping/status.
